from pyspark.sql import SparkSession
from pyspark.sql.functions import col, from_json, lit
from pyspark.sql.types import StructType, StringType, LongType, IntegerType


# 3. Define schemas
aad_user_schema = StructType() \
    .add("aadUser", StructType()
        .add("aadObjectId", StringType())
        .add("orgIdPuid", StringType())
        .add("aadTenantId", StringType()))

user_schema = StructType() \
    .add("user", StructType()
        .add("anid", StringType())
        .add("cid", StringType())
        .add("opid", StringType())
        .add("puid", StringType()))

# 4. Parse each type separately
df_aad = df_Signal_Gen1.withColumn("parsed", from_json("Subject", aad_user_schema)) \
    .filter(col("parsed.aadUser").isNotNull()) \
    .select(
        col("parsed.aadUser.aadObjectId"),
        col("parsed.aadUser.orgIdPuid"),
        col("parsed.aadUser.aadTenantId"),
    ) \
    .withColumn("user_type", lit("aadUser"))

df_user = df_Signal_Gen1.withColumn("parsed", from_json("Subject", user_schema)) \
    .filter(col("parsed.user").isNotNull()) \
    .select(
        col("parsed.user.anid"),
        col("parsed.user.cid"),
        col("parsed.user.opid"),
        col("parsed.user.puid"),
    ) \
    .withColumn("user_type", lit("user"))

# 5. Union all rows into a single DataFrame with outer join schema
df_final = df_aad.unionByName(df_user, allowMissingColumns=True)

# 6. Show result
df_final.show(truncate=False)

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.types import *
import json
import re


spark.conf.set("spark.sql.mapKeyDedupPolicy", "LAST_WIN")

# Parse Properties into map
df = df_Tags_Final.withColumn("PropertiesMap", F.from_json("Properties", MapType(StringType(), StringType())))


# Patch KeyValuePair to override Key → "RetentionPlus30"
df = df.withColumn("PropertiesMap", F.when(
    F.col("FullName") == "Privacy.Asset.KeyValuePair",
    F.map_concat(F.col("PropertiesMap"), F.create_map(F.lit("Key"), F.lit("RetentionPlus30")))
).otherwise(F.col("PropertiesMap")))

# Group by NormalisedPath and ResourceURI
grouped = df.groupBy("NormalisedPath", "ResourceURI").agg(
    F.collect_list(
        F.struct("FullName", "Namespace", "Name", "MetadataType", "PropertiesMap")
    ).alias("tags")
)

# Collect rows to driver for JSON generation
results = grouped.collect()

final_output = []

for row in results:
    normalized_path = row['NormalisedPath']
    resource_uri = row['ResourceURI']
    tags = row['tags']

    asset_tags = []
    column_tags = []
    privacydatatype=[]
    hasLongTailTag= False
    hasIntermediateEngineeringTag=False
    privacySubjectsCounts=0
    
    for tag in tags:
        tag_dict = tag.asDict()
        metadata_type = tag_dict["MetadataType"]
        namespace= tag_dict["Namespace"]
        # privacy_datatype=tag_dict["Namespace"]
        entry = {
            "FullName": tag_dict["FullName"],
            "Namespace": tag_dict["Namespace"],
            "Name": tag_dict["Name"],
            "Properties": tag_dict["PropertiesMap"]
        }
        if tag_dict["Namespace"].startswith("Privacy.Subject"):
            privacySubjectsCounts+=1
        if (tag_dict["Namespace"] == "Privacy.DataType"):
            privacydatatype.append(tag_dict["Name"])
        if(tag_dict["FullName"]=="Privacy.Asset.LongTail"):
            hasLongTailTag: True
        if(tag_dict["FullName"]=="Privacy.Asset.IntermediateEngineering"):
            hasIntermediateEngineeringTag: True
        if metadata_type:
            column_tags.append({
                "Name": tag_dict["Name"],
                "MetadataType": metadata_type,
                "DataType": None,
                "Properties": tag_dict["PropertiesMap"]
            })
        else:
            asset_tags.append(entry)

    final_output.append({
        "NormalizedPath": normalized_path,
        "ResourceURI": resource_uri,
        "AssetTagsList": asset_tags,
        "ColumnList":  column_tags,
        "HasLongTailTag":hasLongTailTag,
        "HasIntermediateEngineeringTag":hasIntermediateEngineeringTag,
        "PrivacyDatatype":privacydatatype,
        "PrivacySubjectsCount":privacySubjectsCounts,
        "LastUpdateDeleteApplied":found_datetime
# Serialize entire row into JSON string

from pyspark.sql.functions import to_json, struct
output_df = spark.createDataFrame([Row(**item) for item in final_output])
# stream_info_df = output_df.select(to_json(struct("*")).alias("StreamInfo"))
